Package parking.domain.repository

package parking.domain.repository
Repository ports (interfaces) for every persistable domain entity.

These interfaces are owned by the domain layer, but are implemented by the parking.infrastructure.repository package. This is the Dependency Inversion Principle at work: the domain defines what persistence it needs, and outer layers provide it, so the dependency arrow always points inward, toward the domain, never outward from it.

  • Interfaces
    Class
    Description
    ParkingSpaceRepository
    Persistence port for ParkingSpace instances.
    ParkingTicketRepository
